why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Pearly White' professionally managed by Stay on 30a, a show-stopping coastal retreat in the heart of Seacrest, where luxury meets laid-back charm. Thoughtfully designed for relaxation, entertainment, and memory-making, this spacious home has everything you need for the ultimate 30A getaway. Dive into your own private screened-in pool complete with ample seating and a gas grill, perfect for poolside lounging or game-day viewing. Practice your short game on the private putting green or kick back in the first-floor game room packed with fun for all ages. Whip up delicious meals in the open kitchen, then gather on the large front porch or retreat to the second-floor covered balcony for sunset cocktails and breezy conversations. With private deeded beach access, six adult bikes, and a 6-seater golf cart, you're just minutes from the sand, scenic 30A trails, and everything Seacrest has to offer. Whether you’re here to play, relax, or explore Pearly White is your dream beach escape, wrapped in style and soaked in sunshine. Welcome to '513 on 30A' by Stay on 30a! Step into laid-back luxury at this brand-new home in the heart of Inlet Beach. With 4 beautifully appointed bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, this stylish retreat comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests and is designed for those who appreciate the finer touches of coastal living. This home features a sleek, modern aesthetic with clean lines, warm textures, and designer finishes throughout. The open-concept layout offers a seamless flow from the kitchen to the dining and living areas, making it the perfect setting for relaxed gatherings after a day at the beach.  Tucked in a quiet, upscale community, guests enjoy access to a community pool. The beach is a short, walk and your toes are in the sand. Included are 6 adult bikes, inviting you to explore 30A like a local, from the boutiques and cafes, to the charming coastal paths that wind through the area. Whether you're sitting on the patio, pedaling to sunset, or simply soaking up the peaceful surroundings, this home offers the perfect balance of modern style and beachside tranquility.  Please note there is a home being built next door, and construction may still be occurring.

White's Gulfview- Private Beach Access at the end of Clareon Dr across Hwy 30A. Gate code found in Welcome Guide. Golf cart parking is available. 2. Seacrest Drive Access is on Scenic 30A at the intersection of Seacrest Drive, just a 3 minute bike ride from the home. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. SEACREST COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Seacrest is casually upscale, making it easy for guests to find endless relaxation. Turn off your phone and forget about your emails as you explore all that Seacrest has to offer. The area s legendary sugar-white sand and turquoise water are only part of what makes Seacrest a true getaway. Grab a bite to eat and a cup of coffee at Seacrest Sundries, the local grocery store, before spending the day wandering through Seacrest s shops and riding bikes along the Timpoochee Trail.
